title: Get involved
meta_description: Volunteering, plots and what needs doing.
sections: Most people start by turning up on a Saturday. After that there are a few other ways to be useful.

1. Easiest

    Saturday mornings

    Just come. Ten till two, every week, whatever the weather. Tools provided.

  2. More

    Take on a bed

    Beds come free a few times a year. There is a waiting list and it moves.

  3. Most

    Join the committee

    Six people, meets monthly, mostly about compost and the water bill. Always needs one more.

HandsSaturdays, and Wednesday evenings in summer
ToolsSpades, forks, anything with a working handle
CompostAlways, endlessly, more than you would think
A treasurerTwo hours a month, and we would be very grateful

What is happening

A short note once a month: what needs doing, what is ready to pick, when the next work day is.

Yes, send me the monthly note. Unsubscribe any time.

We’ll email you a link to confirm. Nothing else is sent until you follow it.
